name: 29mvr-20node-mega-adjudication
description: 29 Malvern Road (Ward) 20-Node JCT Minor Works 2016 Adjudication and High Court Enforcement Pipeline

step.name: m01-contract-grounding
step.prompt: Ground contract under JCT Minor Works 2016 between Red Square Group Ltd (11099300) and Christopher Ward.

step.name: m02-article-3-ca-breach
step.prompt: Forensic audit of CA Article 3 impartiality breach: structural engineer collusion and refusal to certify interim valuations.

step.name: m03-payment-clause-analysis
step.prompt: Audit JCT payment provisions: 4.3.1 (due date), 4.3.2 (CA certificate), 4.5.1 (application), 4.5.2.1 (payment notice default), 4.6.2 (debt obligation).

step.name: m04-absence-of-payless
step.prompt: Establish complete absence of valid Pay Less Notice under s.111 HGCRA 1996 and JCT cl 4.5.4.

step.name: m05-variations-forensic-valuation
step.prompt: Price and substantiate all instructed variations (underpinning, steel beam modifications, architectural changes).

step.name: m06-delay-extension-of-time
step.prompt: Conduct critical path EOT analysis for structural design revisions and party wall award delays.

step.name: m07-loss-and-expense
step.prompt: Quantify direct loss and expense under JCT cl 4.8 (extended site management, scaffolding, plant hire).

step.name: m08-true-value-final-account
step.prompt: Compile true value final account ledger totaling gross valuation less certified payments received.

step.name: m09-tcc-letter-of-claim
step.prompt: Draft formal TCC Letter of Claim specifying statutory debt and alternative true value adjudication.

step.name: m10-notice-of-adjudication
step.prompt: Draft formal Notice of Adjudication under Scheme for Construction Contracts 1998 (single dispute rule).

step.name: m11-anb-application
step.prompt: Submit ANB application to RICS / TeCSA for urgent adjudicator nomination within statutory 5 days.

step.name: m12-referral-notice-assembly
step.prompt: Assemble comprehensive Referral Notice with legal case law citations and evidentiary appendices.

step.name: m13-pearce-high-defect-bar
step.prompt: Establish Pearce & High v Baxter defense against employer allegations of alleged defective works.

step.name: m14-without-prejudice-calderbank
step.prompt: Formulate Calderbank settlement proposal with statutory interest and costs indemnity.

step.name: m15-tcc-cpr-part8-enforcement
step.prompt: Prepare TCC CPR Part 8 / Part 24 High Court summary judgment application under Macob v Morrison.

step.name: m16-charging-order-and-freezing
step.prompt: Draft Interim Charging Order application over 29 Malvern Road property and third-party bank debt order.

step.name: m17-interest-calculation
step.prompt: Calculate Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998 statutory interest (8% + BoE base rate).

step.name: m18-adjudicator-fees-indemnity
step.prompt: Draft demand for full indemnity of adjudicator fees and nominating body application costs.

step.name: m19-multi-channel-service-dispatch
step.prompt: Dispatch full legal pack via Royal Mail Special Delivery tracked, 1st class post, and email.

step.name: m20-final-bench-unanimous-approval
step.prompt: Execute Chief Legal Agent unanimous sign-off across all factual, statutory, and case-law proofs.
